operations.purpose: Inspect accepted inputs, immutable requirements and current run state.
operations.roles: Run submitter or current model owner/co-admin; model-administrator reads are audited. Connector administration and model execution grants alone confer no scientific read access.
operations.retry: Repeat GET using the same resource identity; each request rechecks current credential and resource authority.
operations.guards: No mutation or execution authority is granted.
operations.retained: Run identity; opaque cursor where returned.
operations.next_action: Inspect current state; follow exact referenced artifact identities.

operations.purpose: Follow retained and live logs without treating stream closure as run completion.
operations.roles: Run submitter or current model owner/co-admin; model-administrator reads are audited. Connector administration and model execution grants alone confer no scientific read access.
operations.retry: Reconnect with either the saved Last-Event-ID or cursor, never both.
operations.guards: Credential and current model membership are rechecked before each buffered entry and idle poll.
operations.retained: Run identity and last delivered cursor; on retention gaps, recovery cursor.
operations.next_action: Poll run inspection independently; show retention gaps when resuming.

operations.purpose: List the authenticated submitter's own run history.
operations.roles: Run submitter; model-administrator history uses the model run-history route.
operations.retry: Repeat GET using the same resource identity; each request rechecks current credential and resource authority.
operations.guards: This personal inventory is creator-scoped.
operations.retained: User identity, filters and opaque cursor.
operations.next_action: Inspect a returned run or use model run history for administrative investigation.

operations.purpose: Accept one durable scientific execution intent.
operations.roles: Authorized model user; candidate trials additionally require models:manage and current model-administrator/captured-grant or named-delegation authority.
operations.retry: Persist the request and Idempotency-Key before sending; repeat both unchanged after a lost reply. The same account/key returns the original acceptance receipt, not current run status.
operations.guards: Explicit expected_publication_id, current access/admission and compatible declared inputs. Keys identify semantic requests and belong to the user, not one credential.
operations.retained: API/account, full original body, Idempotency-Key and returned run/receipt identities.
operations.next_action: Inspect the recovered run; a deliberate new execution requires a new key.

operations.purpose: Inspect immutable artifact metadata and current availability.
operations.roles: Artifact creator, or current administrator of a run that produced or accepted the exact artifact dependency. Unrelated standalone uploads remain private.
operations.retry: Repeat GET using the same resource identity; each request rechecks current credential and resource authority.
operations.guards: Knowing an artifact UUID grants no authority.
operations.retained: Artifact UUID and published version/size/SHA-256; never retain capability URLs.
operations.next_action: Use content only when ready; keep immutable identities.

operations.purpose: Authorize an exact-version five-minute object-storage download.
operations.roles: Artifact creator, or current administrator of a run that produced or accepted the exact artifact dependency. Unrelated standalone uploads remain private.
operations.retry: Repeat GET using the same resource identity; each request rechecks current credential and resource authority.
operations.guards: For content, exact published version is verified and credential, membership and availability are rechecked before issuing a 303. Follow Location in a separate storage request without API bearer headers.
operations.retained: Artifact UUID and published version/size/SHA-256; never retain capability URLs.
operations.next_action: Verify full downloaded size and SHA-256; request a fresh capability after expiry.

operations.purpose: List connectors administered by the authenticated account.
operations.roles: Current connector owner/co-admin only; a compute grant alone does not add an entry.
operations.retry: Repeat GET using the same resource identity; each request rechecks current credential and resource authority.
operations.guards: Connector administration is separate from compute-grant discovery.
operations.retained: Pagination cursor and account.
operations.next_action: Grant-only authors use GET /api/v1/compute-grants or enumeray connector grant available.

operations.purpose: Discover active compute grants available to the authenticated account.
operations.roles: Named grant recipient; the grant does not confer connector administration.
operations.retry: Repeat GET using the same resource identity; each request rechecks current credential and resource authority.
operations.guards: Returned grants remain subject to current context and grant policy.
operations.retained: Grant/context identities and pagination cursor.
operations.next_action: Select a personal grant for fresh publication registration.

operations.purpose: List the authenticated account's personal token metadata; default page size 50, maximum 100.
operations.roles: Authenticated account manages its own personal credentials; no model-user or connector role is required.
operations.retry: Repeat inventory GET safely. Token issuance is not an idempotent reservation; after uncertainty inspect inventory before issuing another token.
operations.guards: Requested scopes cannot exceed parent scopes and expiration cannot exceed parent lifetime.
operations.retained: Account, token ID/name/scopes and inventory cursor; token secret is returned only at issuance.
operations.next_action: Save issued secret privately; inventory never reveals it.

operations.purpose: Issue a bounded personal token once; store its returned secret privately.
operations.roles: Authenticated account manages its own personal credentials; no model-user or connector role is required.

operations.guards: Requested scopes cannot exceed parent scopes and expiration cannot exceed parent lifetime.
operations.retained: Account, token ID/name/scopes and inventory cursor; token secret is returned only at issuance.
operations.next_action: Save issued secret privately; inventory never reveals it.

operations.purpose: Reserve exact bytes with durable upload and artifact identities.
operations.roles: Authenticated creator; private reservation ownership does not grant model or connector authority.
operations.retry: Reservation: retry original Idempotency-Key and body. Completion: retry original version_id or multipart:true intent. Current views may refresh temporary instructions; committed receipts retain their identities.
operations.guards: New reservations select multipart strictly above 64 MiB. Single-PUT ceiling, per-file policy, declaration and aggregate quotas are independent. Existing reservations retain transport and expiry.
operations.retained: Same account/assignment, source checksum and unchanged source bytes, original request/key, upload/artifact UUIDs, completion intent and confirmed parts.
errors: 413 metadata/body or general structural byte bound
operations.next_action: Preserve the original operation; inspect to reconcile uncertainty; use completed artifact identity after verification.

operations.purpose: Create a bounded immutable collection operation.
operations.roles: Creator of a user-upload collection for mutations; producing output collections are published only by their assignment connector/session. Reads additionally permit current administrators of an accepting or producing run.
operations.retry: Create with saved key/body; replay member pages at their original index. Freeze/bind/complete repeat unchanged identities. Changed or overlapping page content conflicts.
operations.guards: Freeze metadata before binding verified artifacts. Requested manifest_sha256 and sealed manifest_digest cover different records; use the published byte algorithm.
operations.retained: Collection ID, original key/request, member order/pages, requested digest, member artifact UUIDs and sealed digest.
operations.next_action: Inspect the retained operation and continue its next unfinished step.
